read_only_check_script.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast, hashlib, json, re, shlex, subprocess
root=Path('/workspace/miami-span-observation')
out=Path('/tmp/miami-span-validation')
doc=root/'docs/perf/miami-span-observation-20261103'
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root)
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
head=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
assert head=='e1c6b02bf6660142af3ae575a3b159cd051a011a'
assert not git('diff','--name-only')
assert not git('diff','--cached','--check')
entries={}
for record in git('ls-files','--stage','-z').split(b'\0'):
    if not record: continue
    meta,name=record.split(b'\t',1)
    mode,oid,stage=meta.split()
    assert stage==b'0'
    parts=name.split(b'/')
    node=entries
    for part in parts[:-1]: node=node.setdefault(part,{})
    node[parts[-1]]=(mode,oid)
def tree_hash(node):
    rows=[]
    for name,value in node.items():
        if isinstance(value,dict):
            mode,oid=b'40000',tree_hash(value)
            sortname=name+b'/'
        else:
            mode,oid=value
            sortname=name
        rows.append((sortname,mode+b' '+name+b'\0'+bytes.fromhex(oid.decode())))
    body=b''.join(row for _,row in sorted(rows))
    return hashlib.sha1(b'tree '+str(len(body)).encode()+b'\0'+body).hexdigest().encode()
tree=tree_hash(entries).decode()
assert tree=='c3003d0d8922fb2fed0dd46dd8fdfe7191f631b6'
paths=git('diff','--cached','--name-only','-z').decode().split('\0')[:-1]
expected={'tests/host/miami_span_observation.c','tests/host/run_miami_span_observation.py',*[f'docs/perf/miami-span-observation-20261103/{x}' for x in ['PLAN.md','README.md','results.json','commands.txt','verification.json']]}
assert set(paths)==expected
reviewed={}
for path in paths:
    staged=git('show',':'+path)
    assert staged==(root/path).read_bytes()
    staged.decode('utf-8')
    assert b'\0' not in staged
    reviewed[path]={'sha256':sha(staged),'bytes':len(staged),'git_blob':git('rev-parse',':'+path).decode().strip()}
pin='8be16486e33f65b31c76710e1d825b6aa701c2c9'
assert git('rev-parse',pin+'^{tree}').decode().strip()=='f952ab4455723e4a1a68fdb3a8eea22d2da59710'
blobs={'firmware/src/dsp/original_miami_backend.c':'2efde1794c8454b7af0f9c527f49abd03a28a783','experiments/original_synth/miami_ms20.c':'f74384b3f5e8850339fe4d42309b36fc10dd6b3b'}
for path,blob in blobs.items():
    assert git('rev-parse',pin+':'+path).decode().strip()==blob
    assert git('hash-object',path).decode().strip()==blob
assert not git('diff',pin,'--','firmware','experiments','tools/build.py')
reused=['tests/host/miami_zero_xmod_assessment.c','tests/host/run_miami_zero_xmod_assessment.py','docs/perf/miami-zero-xmod-20261103/results.json']
for path in reused:
    assert git('show',head+':'+path)==(root/path).read_bytes()
prior=json.loads((root/reused[-1]).read_text())
prior_verified=0; prior_missing=[]
for path,digest in prior['input_sha256'].items():
    p=Path(path)
    if p.is_absolute():
        prior_missing.append({'path':path,'exists':p.exists()})
    else:
        assert sha((root/p).read_bytes())==digest,path
        prior_verified+=1
assert prior_verified==176 and len(prior_missing)==3 and not any(x['exists'] for x in prior_missing)
r=json.loads((out/'results.json').read_text())
v=json.loads((doc/'verification.json').read_text())
assert (doc/'results.json').read_bytes()==(out/'results.json').read_bytes()
assert (doc/'commands.txt').read_bytes()==(out/'commands.txt').read_bytes()
assert json.loads(Path('/tmp/miami-span-validation.stdout').read_text())==r
assert not Path('/tmp/miami-span-validation.stderr').read_bytes()
for path,digest in r['input_sha256'].items():
    p=Path(path);p=p if p.is_absolute() else root/p
    assert sha(p.read_bytes())==digest,path
assert len(r['input_sha256'])==181
pcm={}
for factory in (0,15):
    rows=[json.loads(x) for x in (out/f'p{factory}.stdout.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    program=r['programs'][str(factory)];o=program['observations']
    assert len(rows)==3 and rows[0]==rows[1]==program['fixture'] and rows[2]==o
    data=(out/f'baseline-p{factory}.pcm').read_bytes()
    assert data==(out/f'observed-p{factory}.pcm').read_bytes() and len(data)==262144
    assert sha(data)==program['pcm_sha256']==prior['profiles']['baseline'][str(factory)]['pcm_sha256']
    sh=o['span_length_histogram'];vh=o['active_voice_length_histogram'];eh=o['eligible_voice_length_histogram']
    assert sum(sh.values())==o['spans']==1152
    assert sum(int(n)*count for n,count in sh.items())==o['span_frames']==32768
    assert sum(vh.values())==o['active_voice_calls']==2304
    assert sum(int(n)*count for n,count in vh.items())==o['active_voice_frames']==65536
    assert all(vh[k]==2*count for k,count in sh.items())
    assert sum(eh.values())==o['eligible_voice_calls']==36
    assert o['eligible_spans']==18==o['spans']//64
    assert o['voice_calls']==[1152,1152] and o['eligible_voice_ids']==[18,18]
    assert o['complete_state_blocks_compared']==128 and o['backend_state_bytes_per_block']==3840
    assert o['call_order_frames_state_match'] and o['eligibility_boundary_checks']==8
    pcm[str(factory)]={'sha256':sha(data),'bytes':len(data),'spans':o['spans'],'active_voice_calls':o['active_voice_calls'],'eligible_spans':o['eligible_spans'],'eligible_voice_calls':o['eligible_voice_calls'],'eligible_lengths':list(map(int,eh)),'state_images':128,'state_image_bytes':3840}
receipt_paths={'miami-span-red2.stderr':Path('/tmp/miami-span-red2.stderr'),'miami-span-validation.stdout':Path('/tmp/miami-span-validation.stdout'),'p0.stdout.jsonl':out/'p0.stdout.jsonl','p15.stdout.jsonl':out/'p15.stdout.jsonl','negative.stderr':out/'negative.stderr'}
for name,path in receipt_paths.items(): assert sha(path.read_bytes())==v['raw_receipt_sha256'][name]
assert r['negative_observation_test']['exit']==31
assert (out/'negative.stderr').read_text().strip()=='OBSERVATION_MISMATCH observation agrees with actual kernel call'
assert 'RuntimeError: exit 31:' in Path('/tmp/miami-span-red2.stderr').read_text()
assert 'OBSERVATION_MISMATCH span/voice counters' in Path('/tmp/miami-span-red2.stderr').read_text()
assert 'RuntimeError: exit 1:' in Path('/tmp/miami-span-red.stderr').read_text()
assert '"original_miami_voice_render_add" redefined' in Path('/tmp/miami-span-red.stderr').read_text()
backend=(root/'firmware/src/dsp/original_miami_backend.c').read_text()
prefix='#include <stdint.h>\nextern void span_observe_begin(uint32_t);\nextern void span_observe_voice(unsigned,uint32_t);\n'
span_marker='    static float accL[64], accR[64];'
voice_marker='        if (!v->active) continue;\n        if (!completed(s, original_miami_voice_render_add('
assert backend.count(span_marker)==backend.count(voice_marker)==1
expected_backend=prefix+backend.replace(span_marker,span_marker+'\n    span_observe_begin(n);').replace(voice_marker,'        if (!v->active) continue;\n        span_observe_voice(id, n);\n        if (!completed(s, original_miami_voice_render_add(')
assert (out/'observed-backend.c').read_text()==expected_backend
assert (out/'bad-observation-backend.c').read_text()==expected_backend.replace('span_observe_voice(id, n);','span_observe_voice(id, n + 1);')
assert Path('/tmp/miami-span-red2/observed-backend.c').read_text()==backend
ast.parse((root/'tests/host/run_miami_span_observation.py').read_text())
clock_pattern=re.compile(r'\b(?:clock_gettime|gettimeofday|rdtsc|QueryPerformanceCounter|mach_absolute_time|perf_counter|monotonic|timeit|sleep|nanosleep)\b')
assert not clock_pattern.search((root/'tests/host/miami_span_observation.c').read_text())
assert not clock_pattern.search((root/'tests/host/run_miami_span_observation.py').read_text())
commands=(out/'commands.txt').read_text().splitlines()
assert len(commands)==74
assert not any(clock_pattern.search(command) for command in commands)
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','head':head,'staged_tree':tree,'reviewed_files':reviewed,'pins_verified':blobs,'unchanged_pr830_paths':reused,'prior_input_hashes_verified':prior_verified,'prior_generated_inputs_unavailable':prior_missing,'new_input_hashes_verified':len(r['input_sha256']),'raw_receipt_hashes_verified':5,'results_and_commands_byte_identical':True,'stored_command_count':len(commands),'pcm_and_counter_checks':pcm,'generated_backend_edits_only':True,'red2_generated_backend_has_no_hooks':True,'python_ast_parse':'PASS','no_clock_api_matches':'PASS','git_diff_cached_check':'PASS','worktree_matches_index':True,'stored_exits':{'runner':v['runner']['exit'],'program0':r['programs']['0']['exit'],'program15':r['programs']['15']['exit'],'characterization_binary':v['characterization']['exit'],'false_observation':r['negative_observation_test']['exit'],'initial_setup_compile':v['initial_setup_failure']['exit']}},indent=2))

chain_and_state.source_hook_location: Temporary copy only: leaf span after splitting, and active voice after inactive-voice continue, before kernel dispatch.

histogram_and_denominator.denominator: One-based rendered leaf-span ordinal continues across 128 blocks and resets per program/process. Both active voices are included for each eligible span.
histogram_and_denominator.reference: Span/voice/eligible histograms are checked against the unchanged baseline call trace. That derivation uses voice 0 as the span delimiter within this fixed two-active-voice held-note workload.
histogram_and_denominator.sampling_limit: Deterministic selection covers lengths 1,24,37,46,59,63 and is not a representative statistical sample.
